title: Subtracting Fractions With Like Denominators Worksheets
intro: Use like-sized fraction pieces to explain subtraction with like denominators.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Start with a shaded fraction strip and remove the required pieces. Name the remaining pieces without changing their size.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

××

Three green parts remain. Two yellow parts marked × are removed.

5/8 − 2/8 = 3/8

Ask your student

Are these pieces still eighths after we take some away?

If your student needs help

If the student subtracts denominators, point to the equal divisions of the whole strip.
